messages:
anya: pushed a quick token tweak to make dashboard cards denser (space.030 -> space.025, reduced gutter). on staging the primary CTA feels vertically misaligned and two stacked toasts overlap the card header. added screenshots + Percy link in the PR: https://staging.redwood.dev/percy/shot.png

mike: thanks. can you paste the exact token changes here and confirm if list/table rows are impacted?

anya: token snippet:
```diff
- --space-030: 12px;
+ --space-030: 10px; /* narrower */
- --grid-gutter: 24px;
+ --grid-gutter: 16px;
```
I only intended card chrome to tighten for dense dashboards, but didn't run the full visual regressions.

lina: small visual change is fine but looks like `.card-actions` lost vertical centering. quick fix: `.card-actions { display:flex; align-items:center; gap: var(--space-025); }` That should realign the primary button. also suggest adding a compact token alias instead of changing core space.030 globally.

sanjay: toast issue is because toasts are mounted inside document flow with absolute top offsets. when card height is small absolute offsets collide with content. recommendation: create a toast portal (fixed) with stack math applied in JS. sketch:
```css
.toast-portal { position: fixed; right: 16px; bottom: 16px; z-index: 11000; }
.toast { will-change: transform; }
```
compute y offsets in JS on mount to avoid repeated layout reads.

mike: fixed portal makes sense but remember some console pages have a persistent footer bar and occasional bottom drawers. portal should respect a reserved footer variable: `bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + var(--reserved-footer) + 12px)`.

anya: agree. accessibility note: toasts currently use `aria-live: polite` at each toast node which causes multiple announcements. proposal: single live region on the portal with `role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="false"` and programmatically update only the region text with the latest message (visually-hidden) so screen readers announce the newest toast cleanly.

lina: +1. also keyboard behavior: ESC currently closes modals but not toasts. non-persistent toasts should clear on ESC if focus isn't inside a modal or input. add focus-contained checks before dismissing. include a11y tests for screen reader announcements.

sanjay: perf caveat: avoid computing transforms with `calc()` against CSS vars on every render; reading `offsetHeight` repeatedly causes reflow. compute final translateY in JS on mount and set inline style transform. use requestAnimationFrame for initial layout and debounce stack recalculation on window resize.

mike: plan of attack: 1) anya revert the global space.030 change to avoid immediate regressions; 2) implement a toast portal that respects footer/reserved space (sanjay); 3) lina write aria/live behavior and ESC interactions with tests; 4) i'll file a QA regression ticket for card CTA alignment and table row heights. target for PRs tomorrow EOD? :thumbsup:

anya: i'm on it 1 — i'll open a revert and then resurface the dense variant behind `experimental.denseCards` so we can canary on specific pages. will attach updated Percy snapshots.

design-bot: PR #3321 (design token change) assigned to anya  status: needs review.

mike: after revert + portal PRs land, run visual diffs and then we can implement the compact variant behind the feature flag for staged rollout. thanks all.
